errors.evidence: The pie chart contains six categories (slices), not five. The category "Не сме организирали обучения по лидерство" is a distinct category but is not counted.
The sector "От 6 до 15 години" is not uniquely the largest; it is tied for the largest size with the sector "От 1 до 5 години", both at 36.4%.
The value of 13.6% is incorrectly assigned to the category "Под 1 година". The chart shows this value for the category "От 16 до 30 години". The slice for "Под 1 година" has no percentage label.
The chart explicitly labels the sector "От 16 до 30 години" as 13.6%, not approximately 7%.
The chart does not provide a percentage value for the "Над 30 години" category. The value of 'околко 7%' (approximately 7%) is an invention.

errors.text_span: Размерите на секторите изглеждат подредени по низходящ ред.
errors.evidence: The sectors are not arranged in a strictly descending order because the two largest slices are of equal size (36.4%).
The description fails to mention that three of the six slices do not have percentage labels on them: "Под 1 година", "Над 30 години", and "Не сме организирали обучения по лидерство".
